provenance.paper_title: EmbodiedLGR: Integrating Lightweight Graph Representation and Retrieval for Semantic-Spatial Memory in Robotic Agents

evidence.paraphrase: Low-level objects and positions are stored in a semantic graph built from robot observations.
High-level observed-scene descriptions are retained in a RAG store alongside the graph.

The fixed local building pipeline adds observed objects, positions, and scene descriptions to memory. For EmbodiedLGR-Agent, this specifically supports fixed-rule insertion or replacement of semantic object-position graph.
New observations are linked into the semantic graph and retrieval store. For EmbodiedLGR-Agent, this specifically supports relinking or reindexing of stored items of semantic object-position graph.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 2): During inference, the operative memory component (semantic object-position graph) changes through fixed-rule insertion or replacement, relinking or reindexing of stored items; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
